### TDS and Array to release third quarter operating results and host conference call November 6, 2026


October 30, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/566645195/files/doc_news/TDS-and-Array-to-release-third-quarter-operating-results-and-host-conference-call-November-6-2026-2026.pdf)


CHICAGO


, Oct. 30, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Telephone and Data Systems, Inc. (NYSE: TDS) and Array Digital Infrastructure, Inc. (NYSE: AD) will webcast their third quarter operating results conference call on November 6, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Central Time.


The companies will release their financial results on November 6, 2026.


To listen to the webcast, please visit the events & presentations pages of[investors.tdsinc.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810407-1&h=317765146&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tdsinc.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=investors.tdsinc.com%C2%A0) or[investors.arrayinc.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810407-1&h=2494610946&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.arrayinc.com%2F&a=%C2%A0investors.arrayinc.com) . The presentations will be webcast both live and on demand. It is recommended that you register at least 15 minutes before the beginning of the presentation to register, download, and install any necessary multimedia streaming software.


**About TDS**
Founded in 1969, Telephone and Data Systems provides broadband services and wireless infrastructure through its businesses, TDS Telecom and Array Digital Infrastructure, Inc.
